posts.author: Moolian
posts.body:
List of content:
-Mermaid body
-Mermaid ears + optional left ear for the avatar, which works like a rearhair bonus piece (I've included an extra rearhair file with the appropriate name to make it work)
-A "Wing" version of the mermaid tail, which can be used to prevent long hair from covering it
-Two versions of a clothing from the RTP, which have been edited to fit a mermaid
Spoiler:
Example set
Credits:
The mermaid tail is an edited version of
this
sprite made by Jeedai and Pandamaru, so you must credit them if you use it. The clothing comes from the MZ RTP so you must own it. Credit to me is optional.
You will need the
Extended Generator
to use most of these parts.
